why: Rules implementing HB 3773 (US-IL-01), proposed 15 May 2026 and reportedly postponed on 2 June 2026; a proposed or withdrawn rulemaking with no official text located yet, so the extractor may find only the Illinois Register notice, if any.

New fact for US-FL-01: the bill was refiled as SB 2-D in the special session called for 28 Apr to 1 May 2026, passed the Senate on 28 Apr 2026 and died in a House subcommittee on 29 Apr 2026; the record's notes should mention the refiling.

The stored copies of BR-01 are the Chamber and Senate procedure pages, not the bill text; the definitions pilot found no definitions to quote. The full-text link is on the stored Chamber page., added by Michael Riegler: https://www.camara.leg.br/proposicoesWeb/prop_mostrarintegra?codteor=2868197
